Jeff Foxworthy hosted "Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?" and now he’s bringing his Southern charm to Houston. Known for his relatable humor about family and everyday life, Jeff’s observational style is both engaging and hilarious. Expect a night of laughter with one of comedy’s most respected voices. See him live and be part of his journey before he tapes his final TV special. 

The Grand 1894 Opera House - TX · Saturday, May 16, 2026

Seen Ahmed Albasheer on "Larry Charles' Dangerous World of Comedy"? Houston, you’re in for a treat. Ahmed’s humor slices through political chaos with sharp wit. Picture Jon Stewart, but born in Ramadi. His satirical monologues dive into the heart of corruption and extremism. You’ll laugh, think, and see the world a bit differently.
